title: Eval regression telemetry: attribution, noise-filtering, and alert enrichment
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build end-to-end telemetry and alerting changes that tie eval score regressions to specific config or model changes, reduce noisy/duplicate signals, and surface contextual data in Console and downstream notifications (Slack/PagerDuty). This ticket focuses on the attribution pipeline, statistical noise-filtering, alert enrichment payloads, and the minimal Console UI card for change-attribution. Goal is to make regression alerts actionable for SREs/ML engineers: include model/config diff, top failing prompts, and reproducible snapshot links.
acceptance_criteria: A regression alert in Console includes: hypothesis (metric + delta), model/config diff snapshot link, top 5 failing prompts with outputs, and link to failing eval run
Duplicate suppression algorithm prevents >80% of repeated alerts for the same root cause within a 6-hour window while still surfacing new regressions
Slack notifications follow approved template and include ‘Open in Console’ link plus short summary; PagerDuty incidents are generated only for 'high' customer_impact regressions
Automated backfill simulation: run against last 12 weeks of eval runs and demonstrate false positive rate <= 5% for the filtering heuristics
Unit/integration tests cover attribution logic and alert payload generation; PR merged with green CI and an integration smoke test to a staging PagerDuty service
notes: 2026-02-21: Kickoff - scoped to attribution + filtering + enrichment. Decided to prototype with existing eval store (BigQuery) before adding new ingestion paths.

2026-02-24: Design sync - agreed on enrichment fields: model_version, model_hash, config_diff (human diff + machine patch), failing_prompt_examples, eval_metric_histograms, and run_id. UX will show a compact 'Change Attribution' card in the eval detail page.
2026-02-28: Spike results - bootstrapped CI method reduces transient flakiness vs single-run delta. Prototype flags ~3x fewer alerts than naive thresholding on recent dataset.

2026-03-03: Security review request - no secrets in payloads. We will avoid dumping full training data; only store prompt ids and sanitized example outputs. Asked Security to confirm acceptable retention for failing examples.

2026-03-05: Implementation - added attribution function that computes candidate causes: model_version changes, quantization profile changes, batch_size/prefill config, runtime kernel switch. Each cause scored by expected impact computed from recent historical deltas.
2026-03-07: PR feedback (frontend) - console card should show a compact diff summary with an expand to full JSON patch. Frontend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4123

2026-03-10: Ops sync - PagerDuty routing: only escalate when customer_impact=high AND delta magnitude > auto-tuned threshold. Slack channel notifications active for staging: #staging-evals-alerts. Need runbook entry before prod routing.

2026-03-12: Validation - ran backfill across 12 weeks (evals-prod). Filtering removed 82% of duplicate signals (meets goal). Identified edge case: rapid iterative model rollouts produce many semantically distinct but overlapping failures; added semantic-hash grouping heuristic to group by failing prompt signature and diff fingerprint.
